DRAW YOU WAY OUT OF [REDACTED] Pencil - is not only your weapon, but a tool to change the world around you. -Sketch bombs to kick them at your enemies! -Draw doors to kick down! -Write ██████ words on walls – no reason needed! Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionKEEP YOUR CAT EYES SHARP Step into a cozy world of colorful rooms, adorable cats, and little details waiting to fool your eyes. Compare rooms carefully and find everything that has changed. Objects may move, disappear, rotate, change color, or hide somewhere you least expect! TRUST YOUR MEOWMORY Think you can remember every little detail? Study a room carefully, keep its layout in mind and then find what has changed without a side-by-side comparison. If things get tricky, use helpful boosters such as Highlight, Peek and Freeze to give yourself a little extra help. CREATE YOUR PURR-FECT ROOM Take a break from puzzling and become an interior designer! Build your own cozy rooms from scratch and make them truly yours with over 870 customization items, including furniture, decorations, plants, floors, walls and more! Arrange everything just the way you like, experiment with colors and create a cozy space for your feline friends. Collect 2 adorable kitties and watch them wander around the room as you enjoy your creation. TWO PLAYERS, TWICE THE PURR Challenge a friend in local multiplayer and see who can spot the differences faster! Play together on one screen, put your observation skills to the test and turn every cozy room into a little friendly competition. FEATURES: • Spot the Difference - Compare 2 rooms and find objects that have moved, disappeared, rotated, changed color or been replaced • Memory Rooms - Study a room carefully, remember every detail and then find what has changed • Cozy Room Editor - Build and decorate your own cozy rooms from scratch! • Over 870 Customization Items - Choose from furniture, decorations, plants, floors, walls and more to create your perfect cozy space • Local Multiplayer - Challenge a friend and see who can spot the differences faster • Cute Kitties - Collect 2 adorable feline friends that wander around the room • Custom Memory Challenges - Choose the number of differences, Time to Look, Time to Spot and Allowed Mistakes • Helpful Boosters - Use Highlight, Peek and Freeze when you need a little help Spot the little things, create cozy spaces and enjoy every meow-ment!Show morePublished byQubicGames S.A.
